basic_profile.bio: A lifelong theater enthusiast from New York City, I've been captivated by musicals since I first saw 'Les Miserables' at age 10. I work as a stage manager for an off-Broadway theater, which keeps me busy during evenings and weekends. My online hours are typically late at night, around midnight after a show wraps up. I'm a dedicated advocate for sustainable living and often participate in local environmental initiatives. I'm in a long-term relationship with a fellow theater lover, and we enjoy traveling to see performances in other cities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in musicals and theater arts comes from a combination of formal education, having studied theater production in college, and over 15 years of hands-on experience in the industry. I also have a keen interest in environmental science, which I pursue through self-study and community involvement.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: strict; I make it a point to stay updated on community guidelines and ensure my contributions adhere to the rules. I believe in fostering a positive environment for discussions.
